<script>
function saveSvgFromParentDiv(divElId, name) {
  var divSvgWrapperEl = document.getElementById(divElId);

  var svgEl = divSvgWrapperEl.firstElementChild;
  svgEl.setAttribute("xmlns", "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg");
  var svgData = svgEl.outerHTML;
  var preface = '<?xml version="1.0" standalone="no"?>\r\n';
  var svgBlob = new Blob([preface, svgData], {type:"image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"});
  var svgUrl = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
  var downloadLink = document.createElement("a");
  downloadLink.href = svgUrl;
  downloadLink.download = name;
  document.body.appendChild(downloadLink);
  downloadLink.click();
  document.body.removeChild(downloadLink);
}

function saveSvgFromParentDiv2(clickedEl, downloadName) {

  var svgEl = clickedEl.previousElementSibling;
  svgEl.setAttribute("xmlns", "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg");
  var svgData = svgEl.outerHTML;
  var preface = '<?xml version="1.0" standalone="no"?>\r\n';
  var svgBlob = new Blob([preface, svgData], {type:"image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"});
  var svgUrl = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
  
  _createThenClickImageLink(svgUrl, downloadName);
}

function savePngFromParentDiv(clickedEl, downloadName) {
  var imgEl = clickedEl.previousElementSibling;
  
  _createThenClickImageLink(imgEl.src, downloadName);
}

function _createThenClickImageLink(imageUrl, downloadName) {
  var downloadLink = document.createElement("a");
  downloadLink.href = imageUrl;
  downloadLink.download = downloadName;
  
  document.body.appendChild(downloadLink);
  downloadLink.click(); // triggers image download
  document.body.removeChild(downloadLink);
}
</script>

```{r helpers_png_svg, include=FALSE}

## Creating helper functions for PNG or SVG files ##

#Creating a temp file to load images, to be deleted at the end
if(dir.exists("temp") == FALSE){
  dir.create("temp")
}

# Function createPngOrSvg for creating images from plots
createPngOrSvg <- function(plot_data, image_name, w, h) {
  
  if (format_svg) {
    
    # Code for creating svg images (no temp file)
    s <- svgstring(width=w,height=h)
    plot(plot_data)
    invisible(dev.off())
  
    return(paste0("<div id='svgWrapper'>",s(),"<a class='no-print' href='javascript:void(0);' onclick=\"javascript:saveSvgFromParentDiv2(this,'",image_name,".svg');\" >Save figure</a></div>"))
    
  } else {
    
    # Code for saving png images (temp file used)
    png_file <- paste0("./temp/",image_name, ".png")
    png(filename = png_file, width = w, height = h, type = "cairo")
    plot(plot_data)
    invisible(dev.off())
    
    png_binary <- readBin(png_file, what = "raw", n = file.info(png_file)$size)
    png_base64 <- base64encode(png_binary)
    
     return(paste0("<div id='pngWrapper'> <img src='data:image/png;base64,",png_base64,"' ><a  href='javascript:void(0);' onclick=\"javascript:savePngFromParentDiv(this, '",image_name,".png');\" >Save figure</a></div>"))
    
  }
}

# Function createPngOrSvgForGrid for creating images from grids (heatmaps, for example)
createPngOrSvgForGrid <- function(plot_data1, plot_data2, image_name) {
  
  if (format_svg) {
    
    # Code for creating svg image (no temp file)
    s <- svgstring(width=20,height=10)
    grid.arrange(arrangeGrob(plot_data1), arrangeGrob(plot_data2), ncol=2,nrow=1)
    invisible(dev.off())
  
    return(paste0("<div id='svgWrapper'>",s(),"<a class='no-print' href='javascript:void(0);' onclick=\"javascript:saveSvgFromParentDiv2(this,'",image_name,".svg');\" >Save figure</a></div>"))
    
  } else {
    
    # Code for creating png image (temp file used)
    png_file <- paste0("./temp/",image_name, ".png")
    png(filename = png_file, width = 1200, height = 600, type = "cairo")
    grid.arrange(arrangeGrob(plot_data1), arrangeGrob(plot_data2), ncol=2,nrow=1)
    invisible(dev.off())
    
    png_binary <- readBin(png_file, what = "raw", n = file.info(png_file)$size)
    png_base64 <- base64encode(png_binary)
    
     return(paste0("<div id=pngWrapper><img src='data:image/png;base64,",png_base64,"' ><a  href='javascript:void(0);' onclick=\"javascript:savePngFromParentDiv(this, '",image_name,".png');\" >Save figure</a></div>"))
    
  }
}
```

```{r file_import, echo=FALSE}

## Importing and parsing data file ##

data<- read.csv(params$quant_df, check.names = F, sep="\t")

# Saving original accession columns before pre-processing 
# (for later joining to original in output_file)
og_Acc <- data[grepl("Accession",colnames(data))]

# Creating a display label for each for each protein
# Using Gene_name when available, Accession otherwise
# Making sure Labels are unique
data <- data %>% mutate(Label=Gene_name) %>%
  relocate(Label,.after = "Gene_name") %>%
  mutate(Label=if_else(is.na(Label),Accession,Label)) %>% #if gene_name is NA, use Accession
  group_by(Label) %>% 
   mutate(Label = case_when(
    n() > 1 ~ paste0(Label, "_", Accession),  # Modify only duplicated labels
    TRUE ~ Label  # Keep unique labels as they are
  )) %>%
  ungroup()

# Importing experimental design and parameters
expDesign <- read.csv(params$design_exp, header = T, sep="\t")
parameters <- read.csv(params$parameters, header=T, sep="=")
```

```{r param_parsing}

## Parsing parameters ##

# T or F using imputation
imputation <- !as.logical(parameters["No.imputed.values",])

# SVG or PNG images
if(as.character(parameters["Figure.format",]) == "SVG"){
  format_svg <- TRUE
}else{
  format_svg <- FALSE
}

# T or F coloring by group
coloring_by_group <- as.logical(parameters["Color.by.group",])

# Style of volcano plot
Vol_colors <- as.character(parameters["Volcano.color.style",])

# Specified proteins for normalization
Normalization_list <- as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(parameters["Proteins.for.normalization",]),";")[[1]])

# Specified proteins for labeling on volcano plot
Vol_labels <- strsplit(as.character(parameters["Volcano.manual.accession",]),";")[[1]]

# T or F labeling on volcano plot
Vol_no_lab <- as.logical(parameters["Volcano.no.labeling",])

# T or F for normalization
normalization <- as.logical(parameters["Normalization",])

# MCAR assumed unless MNAR set
imputation_method <- parameters["Imputation.MCAR.model",]

# Setting minimum knn occurances
Imputation.knn.min.occurrences = as.numeric(as.character(parameters["Imputation.knn.min.occurrences",]))

# Setting MCAR threshold for number of observations
Imputation.MCAR.threshold.obs = as.numeric(as.character(parameters["Imputation.MCAR.threshold.obs",]))

# Setting MCAR threshold for number of by MS/MS needed
Imputation.MCAR.threshold.MSMS = as.numeric(as.character(parameters["Imputation.MCAR.threshold.MSMS",]))

# Getting MNAR model
Imputation.MNAR.model <- parameters["Imputation.MNAR.model",]

# Setting MNAR model percentile cutoff
Imputation.MNAR.percentage <- as.numeric(as.character(parameters["Imputation.MNAR.percentile",]))

# Determines which fold-change column is used (fc or zscore)
Fold.Change = as.character(parameters["Fold.Change",])

# Setting pvalue threshold for volcano plot
Volcano.threshold.pvalue = as.numeric(as.character(parameters["Volcano.threshold.pvalue",]))

# Setting fc threshold for volcano plot
Volcano.threshold.fc = as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(parameters["Volcano.threshold.fc",]),";")[[1]])

# Setting pvalue calculation test type
Test.type <- parameters["Test.type",]

# If using logged values for significance test (T/F)
Test.log <- parameters["Test.log",]

# Setting conditions for DA comparison
comparisons_to_display = strsplit(as.character(parameters["Comparisons",]),";")[[1]]

# Setting threshold for pvalue in volcano plot
Volcano.threshold.pvalue = as.numeric(as.character(parameters["Volcano.threshold.pvalue",]))

# Setting if test is paired
Test.paired <- as.logical(parameters["Test.paired",])

# Setting for equal variance
Test.var.equal <- as.logical(parameters["Test.var.equal",])

# Setting alternative options for testing
alternative=as.character(parameters["Test.alternative",])

# Setting test adjustment procedure
Test.adjust.procedure <- as.character(parameters["Test.adjust.procedure",])

# Setting adjusted FDR for significance test
Test.adjust.FDR <- parameters["Test.adjust.FDR",]
```

```{r normalization}

## If the normalization T, parsing for the normalization plots ##

if (normalization){
  
  # Write.csv(data, "data")
  raw_abundance = data[c("Id",as.character(expDesign$File))]
  
  # If list of proteins to normalize to is specified, create a subset
  if(length(Normalization_list) > 0){
    sub_df <- subset(raw_abundance, raw_abundance$Id%in%Normalization_list)
  }
  
  # Find the sample with the least NA
  na_count_by_sample = fast_apply_nb_na(as.matrix(raw_abundance[,-1]),2)
  na_by_sample = data.frame(na_count_by_sample,colnames(raw_abundance[,-1]))
  reference_sample = as.character(subset(na_by_sample,na_by_sample$na_count_by_sample==min(na_by_sample$na_count_by_sample))[,2][1])
  
  # Normalization
  # If list of proteins to normalize to is specified, normalize to this subset
  if(length(Normalization_list) > 0){
    normalized_abundance = new_normalization(sub_df, raw_abundance, reference_sample)
  }
  # Else, normalize to all proteins in the reference sample (least NA values)
  else{
    normalized_abundance = normalize(raw_abundance,reference_sample)
  }
  
  # Merging normalized values with data, and creating normalized_abundance var
  data = merge.data.frame(data,normalized_abundance,by="Id")
  normalized_abundance = normalized_abundance[,grepl("_norm",colnames(normalized_abundance))]
  
  pattern="_norm"
}else{
  pattern=""
}
```

```{r mean_technical_replicates, results='asis'}

## Parsing of sample data into created group_ids list.  Combining technical replicates into biological-replicate-level means ##

# Creating data frame containing ID - from data - for mean_abundance
mean_abundance_repbio = data.frame(data$Id)
colnames(mean_abundance_repbio) = "Id"

# Creating data frame containing ID - from data - for mean_identification_type
mean_identification_type_repbio = data.frame(data$Id)
colnames(mean_identification_type_repbio) = "Id"

# Looping over each experimental condition or "group"
for(group in group_ids){
  
  # Taking the subset of experimental design associated with this condition
  sub = subset(expDesign,expDesign$Condition==group)
  
  # Looping over each replicate within this condition
  for (rBio in unique(sub$repBio)){
    
    # Getting intensity columns and converting their names to the corresponding identification type column names
    samples_intensities = subset(sub,sub$repBio==rBio)$File
    samples_identification_type = paste0("Identification_type",sub("Intensity","",samples_intensities))
    
    # if a bio-rep contains multiple technical replicates
    if(length(samples_intensities)>1){
      
      # Average the abundance/intensity values, and appending then to the end of bio-rep table
      mean_ab = rowMeans(data[paste0(as.character(samples_intensities),pattern)],na.rm=T)
      mean_abundance_repbio = cbind(mean_abundance_repbio,mean_ab)
      
      # Collapsing identification types across technical replicates, if not classified as "By MS/MS" classify as "By matching".
      id_type = apply(data[samples_identification_type],1,function(x) ifelse("By MS/MS"%in%x,"By MS/MS","By matching"))
      mean_identification_type_repbio = cbind(mean_identification_type_repbio,id_type)
      
    }else{ # If a bio-rep has only one technical replicate
      
      # Copying original abundance/intensity column
      mean_abundance_repbio = cbind(mean_abundance_repbio,data[paste0(as.character(samples_intensities),pattern)])
      mean_identification_type_repbio = cbind(mean_identification_type_repbio,data[samples_identification_type])
      
    }
    
    # Renaming most recent mean abundance column to include "_mean" and identification column to include "_identification_type"
    colnames(mean_abundance_repbio)[ncol(mean_abundance_repbio)] = paste0(rBio,"_",group,"_mean")
    colnames(mean_identification_type_repbio)[ncol(mean_identification_type_repbio)] = paste0(rBio,"_",group,"_identification_type")
  }
}

# Adding mean_abundance and mean_identification_type columns to main data set
data = merge.data.frame(data,mean_abundance_repbio,by="Id")
data = merge.data.frame(data,mean_identification_type_repbio,by="Id")
```


```{r proteins_filtered_diagramm}

## Parsing of data input file to separate by specific peptides ##

# Creating function for dataset filtering
filter_dataset <- function(data, group_ids){
  
  # If data contains Specific_peptides column, remove proteins with 0 specific peptides
  if("Specific_peptides"%in%colnames(data)){
    nb = nrow(data)
    data = subset(data,data[,"Specific_peptides"]>0)
    nb_specific = nb-nrow(data)
  }
   
  ## Creates a filtered data set based in the raw data file given in the parameters. Flags and filters out any specific protein that has insufficient data. If the final filtered data set is empty, throws an error ##
  
  # Parsing minimum required thresholds from parameters
  Filter.threshold.obs = as.numeric(as.character(parameters["Filter.threshold.obs",]))
  Filter.threshold.ms = as.numeric(as.character(parameters["Filter.threshold.ms",]))
  
  filtered_data = data
  nb_obs = 0
  nb_ms = 0
  
  # Looping through each protein/row
  for (row in 1:nrow(data)){
    
    protein = data[row,]
    enough=T
    
    # Collecting all identification type columns and counting all "By MS/MS"
    identification = protein[grep("Identification_type_",colnames(protein))]
    sum = sum(identification=="By MS/MS", na.rm=T)
    
    # If number of MS/MS identifications is below threshold
    if(sum<Filter.threshold.ms){
      # Exclude and tick up counter for excluded from lack of MS/MS
        enough=F
        nb_ms=nb_ms+1
    }
    else{
      # Count how many groups don't have enough observed values
      cptr_not_enough = 0
      for(group in group_ids){
        # Selecting bio-replicate mean columns 
        aValues = protein[paste0(get(as.character(group)),"_mean")]
        na = is.na(aValues)
        # If the fraction of observed values is below the threshold, count the group as insufficient
        if((sum(na==F)/length(na))<Filter.threshold.obs){
          cptr_not_enough = cptr_not_enough+1
        }
      }
      # If the protein was found insufficient in all groups, exclude it and tick up counter for excluded for # observations
      if (cptr_not_enough==length(group_ids)){
        enough=F
        nb_obs = nb_obs+1
      }
    }
    # If the protein was market for exclusion, take it out of the filtered dataset
    if (enough==F){
      filtered_data = subset(filtered_data,filtered_data$Id!=protein$Id)
    }
  }
  
  # Count the number of proteins in the filtered dataset
  nbProteins = nrow(filtered_data)
  
  # Subsets for raw abundance and mean_abundance for filtered proteins
  filtered_raw_abundance = filtered_data[c("Id",as.character(expDesign[expDesign$Condition == group_ids,]$File))]
  mean_abundance_repbio = filtered_data[,grepl("_mean|Id$",names(filtered_data))]
  
  # If the sub-dataset for mean_abundance is 0 (all proteins filtered out), throw error
  if (nrow(mean_abundance_repbio) == 0) {
    stop("Can't continue since the number of rows after applied filters is zero. Please check 'Filter.threshold' parameters (try to set lower values).")
  }
  
  ## Designing and framing of 'Proteins Filtered' bar chart ##
  
  # Summary table for filtering results
  diagrammDFT <- data.frame(
    filter = c("No specific peptides",
              paste0("Less than ",(Filter.threshold.obs * 100),"% observations in at least one group"), 
              paste0("Less than ",Filter.threshold.ms," files identified by MS/MS"),
              "Proteins kept for analysis"),
    value = c(nb_specific, nb_obs, nb_ms, nbProteins)
    ) %>%
    mutate(value.percent = round(.$value / sum(.$value) * 100, 1),
           filter = factor(.$filter, levels = .$filter[1:4]))
  
  # Diagram to be used for the bar plot
  diagrammDF <- data.frame(
    filter = c(paste0(diagrammDFT$value[1], " (", diagrammDFT$value.percent[1], "%) No specific peptides"),
              paste0(diagrammDFT$value[2], " (", diagrammDFT$value.percent[2],"%) Less than ",(Filter.threshold.obs * 100),"% observations in at least one group"), 
              paste0(diagrammDFT$value[3], " (", diagrammDFT$value.percent[3],"%) Less than ",Filter.threshold.ms," files identified by MS/MS"),
              paste0(diagrammDFT$value[4], " (", diagrammDFT$value.percent[4],"%) Proteins kept for analysis")),
    value = c(nb_specific, nb_obs, nb_ms, nbProteins)
    ) %>%
    mutate(value.percent = round(.$value / sum(.$value) * 100, 1),
           filter = factor(.$filter, levels = .$filter[1:4]))
  
  # Filtering results bar plot:
  diagramm <- ggplot(diagrammDF, aes(x = "", y = value, fill = filter)) +
    geom_bar(width = .5, stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette="Blues") +
    xlab("") +
    ylab("") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size=22),
          legend.text = element_text(size=21))

  return(list(filtered_data, mean_abundance_repbio, filtered_raw_abundance, diagrammDFT, diagramm))
}

```

```{r normalization_plots, results='asis'}

## Framing of 'Intensity distribution before normalization' line graph ##

# If normalization parameter is TRUE
if (normalization){
  
  # Creating subset of data containing Id and normalized abundance
  normalized_abundance = data[c("Id",paste0(as.character(expDesign$File),"_norm"))]
  
  # Creating a 2 column dataframe with sample and intensity
  df_raw_intensity = reshape2::melt(raw_abundance[-1])
  colnames(df_raw_intensity) = c("Sample","Intensity")
  df_raw_intensity$Sample = sub("Intensity_","",df_raw_intensity$Sample)
  
  # Verifying there are no na or 0 values before logging in density plot
  df_raw_intensity$Intensity <- as.numeric(df_raw_intensity$Intensity)
  df_raw_intensity <- df_raw_intensity[!is.na(df_raw_intensity$Intensity) & df_raw_intensity$Intensity > 0, ]

  # Plotting density plot of raw log10 intensities
  density1 <- ggplot(data = df_raw_intensity) +
    geom_density(mapping = aes(x=log10(as.numeric(Intensity)),group=Sample,color=Sample), na.rm = T) +
    ggtitle("Intensity distribution before normalization")+
    xlab("log(intensity)")+
    {if (coloring_by_group) scale_color_manual(values = sample_colors)}+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size=22),
          axis.title=element_text(size=18),
          axis.text.y=element_text(angle=90,size=18),
          axis.text.x=element_text(size=18),
          legend.text=element_text(size=16),
          legend.title=element_text(size=18))
  
  # Printing density plot to report output (SVG or PNG)
  if (format_svg) {
    cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(density1,"Intensity_distribution_before_normalization", 12, 8)))
  } else {
    cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(density1,"Intensity_distribution_before_normalization", 1600, 800)))
  }
    
  cat(text_spec("\n"))  
  
  # Creating a 2 column dataframe with sample and normalized intensity
  df_norm_intensity = reshape2::melt(normalized_abundance[-1])
  colnames(df_norm_intensity) = c("Sample","Intensity")
  df_norm_intensity$Sample = sub("Intensity_","", df_norm_intensity$Sample)
  df_norm_intensity$Sample = sub("_norm","", df_norm_intensity$Sample)
  
  # Verifying there are no na or 0 values before logging in normalized density plot
  df_norm_intensity$Intensity <- as.numeric(df_norm_intensity$Intensity)
  df_norm_intensity <- df_norm_intensity[!is.na(df_norm_intensity$Intensity) & df_norm_intensity$Intensity > 0, ]

  # Plotting density plot of normalized log10 intensities
  density2 <- ggplot(data = df_norm_intensity) +
    geom_density(mapping = aes(x=log10(as.numeric(Intensity)),group=Sample,color=Sample), na.rm = T) +
    ggtitle("Intensity distribution after normalization")+
    xlab("log(intensity)")+
    {if (coloring_by_group) scale_color_manual(values = sample_colors)}+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size=22),
          axis.title=element_text(size=18),
          axis.text.y=element_text(angle=90,size=18),
          axis.text.x=element_text(size=18),
          legend.text=element_text(size=16),
          legend.title=element_text(size=18))
  
  # Printing normalized density plot to report output (SVG or PNG)
  if (format_svg) {
    cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(density2,"Intensity_distribution_after_normalization", 12, 8)))
  } else {
    cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(density2,"Intensity_distribution_after_normalization", 1600, 800)))
  }

  # Printing explanation of normalization methods into html doc
  cat(text_spec(paste0("\n Normalization method : each intensity is expressed relatively to a reference intensity, as a ratio of intensities. Intensities of the sample with the lowest number of missing values (",reference_sample,") are used as reference intensities. Intensities are then centered by substracting the median of the ratios for each sample."),italic=T,font_size="12px"))

}else{

  # If no normalization, printed statement
  cat(text_spec("Intensities were not normalized.",italic=T,font_size="12px"))

}
```

```{r na_distribution, results='asis'}

## Calculating missing values per group ##

# Dataframe storing the median abundance accross bio-reps and number of missing values
na_distribution = data.frame(median=numeric(),sum_na=numeric())

# Dataframe that will store missing value percentages per group
na_percentage = data.frame(Group=character(),na_percentage=character(),na_count=character())

# Looping through each group
for(Group in group_ids){
  
  # Selecting the bio-rep mean abundance columns for this group and adding a check if no mean_abundance found
  # current_group_intensities = mean_abundance_repbio[paste0(get(as.character(Group)),"_mean")]
  current_group_cols <- grep(paste0("_", Group, "_mean$"), colnames(mean_abundance_repbio), value = TRUE)
  
  if (length(current_group_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No mean abundance columns found for group: ", Group)
  }
  
  current_group_intensities <- mean_abundance_repbio[current_group_cols]
  current_group_intensities_nrows = nrow(current_group_intensities)
  
  # Only calculating missing-value summaries if the table contains rows
  if (current_group_intensities_nrows > 0 ) {
    
    # Calculating the percentage of missing values and adding it to the missing values summary
    na_count = sum(is.na(current_group_intensities))
    NA_percentage = na_count/(current_group_intensities_nrows*ncol(current_group_intensities))*100
    na_percentage = rbind(na_percentage,data.frame(Group,NA_percentage,na_count))

    # Adding median and sum_na culumns to the missingness distribution table
    current_group_intensities$median = rowMedians(as.matrix(current_group_intensities),na.rm = T)
    current_group_intensities$sum_na = as.factor(apply(current_group_intensities[-ncol(current_group_intensities)],1,function(x) sum(is.na(x))))
    na_distribution = rbind(na_distribution,current_group_intensities[,(ncol(current_group_intensities)-1):ncol(current_group_intensities)])
  }

}
# Add a final row summarizing across groups
mean_abundance_only <- mean_abundance_repbio[, grepl("_mean$", colnames(mean_abundance_repbio)), drop = FALSE]
na_percentage = rbind(na_percentage, data.frame(Group="All groups",
                                                NA_percentage=sum(is.na(mean_abundance_only))/(nrow(mean_abundance_only)*ncol(mean_abundance_only))*100,
                                                na_count=sum(is.na(mean_abundance_only))))

```

```{r missing_values_imputation, results='asis'}


## If MCAR IMPUTATION parameter is not set to MNAR, MCAR data is parsed and a data frame is created ##

if(imputation_method != "MNAR"){
  
  # MCAR processing by condition (group)
  for(group in group_ids){
    
    # Select bio-reps for this group and matching identification_type columns for this group
    group_mean_cols <- grep(paste0("_", group, "_mean$"), colnames(mean_abundance_repbio), value = TRUE)
    
    if (length(group_mean_cols) == 0) {
      stop("No mean abundance columns found for group: ", group)
    }
    
    intensities_current_condition = data.frame(data$Id,mean_abundance_repbio[group_mean_cols],check.names=F)
    intensities_current_condition <- intensities_current_condition %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
    identification_type_current_condition = data.frame(data[grepl(paste0("^Id$|",group,"_identification_type$"),names(data))],check.names=F)
    
    # Run MCAR imputation method using thresholds
    imputed_intensities = impute_mcar(intensities_current_condition,
                                      identification_type_current_condition,
                                      as.character(parameters["Imputation.MCAR.model",]),
                                      Imputation.MCAR.threshold.obs,
                                      Imputation.MCAR.threshold.MSMS,
                                      Imputation.knn.min.occurrences,
                                      data)

    # Rename imputed columns with _mcar suffix
    colnames(imputed_intensities) = paste0(sub("_mean","",colnames(imputed_intensities)),"_mcar")
    colnames(imputed_intensities)[1] = colnames(data)[1]
    
    # Add the mcar imputed columns to the main dataframe
    data = merge.data.frame(data,imputed_intensities,by=colnames(data)[1])
  
  }
  
  # Setting pattern to _mcar for later column finding
  pattern = "_mcar"
  
}else{
  
  # If no mcar imputation, set pattern to _mean
  pattern = "_mean"
}

## MNAR IMPUTATION ##

# If MCAR IMPUTATION parameter is set to MNAR, data is taken for either the Gaussian or Percentile models
intensities_to_impute = data[grepl(paste0(pattern,"$|Id$"),colnames(data))]

# Imputing Gaussian or Percentile models per parameter
if(Imputation.MNAR.model == "gaussian"){
  imputation_results = impute_background_noise_gaussian(intensities_to_impute)
  gaussian_parameters = c(imputation_results[[1]],imputation_results[[2]])
  imputed_abundance = imputation_results[[3]]
}else if(Imputation.MNAR.model == "percentile"){
    percentile = Imputation.MNAR.percentile/100
    imputed_abundance = impute_background_noise_percentile(intensities_to_impute,percentile)
}

# Replacing MCAR values with NA values (marked values)
imputed_abundance[imputed_abundance=="MCAR"] <- NA

# Add imputed abundance columns back to main dataframe
data = merge.data.frame(data,imputed_abundance,by="Id")

# Keep ID column, log transform the rest
imputed_abundance_values <- imputed_abundance[, 2:ncol(imputed_abundance)]

imputed_abundance_values <- data.frame(
  lapply(imputed_abundance_values, as.numeric),
  check.names = FALSE
)

imputed_abundance_values[imputed_abundance_values <= 0] <- NA

imputed_abundance_log <- data.frame(
  Id = imputed_abundance[, 1],
  log10(imputed_abundance_values),
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(imputed_abundance_log)[2:ncol(imputed_abundance_log)] <- paste0(
  colnames(imputed_abundance)[2:ncol(imputed_abundance)],
  "_log"
)

data = merge.data.frame(data,imputed_abundance_log,by="Id")

# Make a data frame of values to plot
imputed_abundance_log = data[grepl("_log$|Id$",colnames(data))]
imputationDF = reshape2::melt(imputed_abundance_log[,-1])
colnames(imputationDF) = c("Sample","log_abundance")

# If imputation is enabled, also create a log-transformed version of the original bio-rep mean abundance table
if(imputation){
  abundance_log = mean_abundance_repbio
  abundance_log[,2:ncol(abundance_log)] = log10(data.matrix(abundance_log[,2:ncol(abundance_log)]))
  colnames(abundance_log)[2:ncol(abundance_log)] = paste0(colnames(mean_abundance_repbio)[2:ncol(abundance_log)],"_noimpute_log")
  
  data = merge.data.frame(data,abundance_log,by="Id")
  
  # Make a data frame of values to plot
  abundance_log = data[grepl("_noimpute_log$|Id$",colnames(data))]
  abundanceDF = reshape2::melt(abundance_log[,-1])
  colnames(abundanceDF) = c("Sample","log_abundance")
}

# Identifying values that were missing before imputation
imputed = reshape2::melt(is.na(mean_abundance_repbio[,-1]))
imputationDF = cbind(imputationDF,imputed$value)
colnames(imputationDF) = c("Sample","Intensity","Is_imputed")

# Framing of 'Log intensities distribution with imputed values' histogram
histogram <- ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(data = imputationDF, mapping = aes(x = Intensity, fill = Is_imputed), alpha=0.7, bins = 100) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("dodgerblue3", "darkorchid4"))+
  ggtitle("Log intensities distribution with imputed values") +
  xlab("log(intensity)")+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=22),
          axis.title=element_text(size=22),
          axis.text=element_text(size=22),
          legend.text=element_text(size=22),
          legend.title=element_text(size=22))

# Printing 'Log intensities distribution with imputed values' histogram into html document (.svg or .png dependent on set parameters) with download link
if (format_svg) {
  htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(histogram,"Log_intensities_distribution_with_imputed_values", 12, 10))
} else {
  htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(histogram,"Log_intensities_distribution_with_imputed_values", 1600, 600))
}

# If Gaussian MNAR model is created, prints explanation of median and sd figures used
if(exists("gaussian_parameters")){
  cat(text_spec(paste0("The gaussian model has a median of ", formatC(gaussian_parameters[1],format = "e", digits=2), " and a sd of ",formatC(gaussian_parameters[2],format = "e", digits=2),"."),italic=T,font_size="12px"))
}
```

```{r compute_cv_distribution, results='asis', message=F}

## Within-group comparison of variation before and after pre-processing/imputation ##

# Initializing output tables, one row per filtered protein
df_median_deviation_before_processing = seq(1,nrow(filtered_data)) #data
df_median_deviation_after_processing = seq(1,nrow(filtered_data)) #data

df_cv_before_processing = seq(1,nrow(filtered_data)) #data
df_cv_after_processing = seq(1,nrow(filtered_data)) #data

# Looping through each experimental group
for (group in group_ids){
  
  # Selecting bio-rep mean abundance columns for group
  before_cols <- grep(paste0(group, "_mean$"), names(filtered_data), value = TRUE)
  
  # Verifies that columns were found/selected, then adding them to subset
  if (length(before_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No before-processing mean columns found for group: ", group)
  }
  intensities = filtered_data[before_cols]

  # Compute median deviation for the selected group columns
  intensities_median_deviation = compute_median_deviation(intensities)
  colnames(intensities_median_deviation) = rep(group,ncol(intensities_median_deviation))
  
  # Add median deviation and CV values to before-imputation tables
  df_median_deviation_before_processing = cbind(df_median_deviation_before_processing,intensities_median_deviation)
  df_cv_before_processing = cbind(df_cv_before_processing,compute_cv(intensities))

  # Select post-imputation columns for this group
  after_cols <- grep(paste0(group, ".*_imputed$"), names(filtered_data), value = TRUE)
  
  # Verifies that columns were found/selected, then adding them to subset
  if (length(after_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No after-processing imputed columns found for group: ", group)
  }
  intensities = filtered_data[after_cols]

  # Computing median deviation for the selected group columns
  intensities_median_deviation = compute_median_deviation(intensities)
  colnames(intensities_median_deviation) = rep(group,ncol(intensities_median_deviation))
  
  # Adding median deviation and CV values to after-imputation tables
  df_median_deviation_after_processing = cbind(df_median_deviation_after_processing,intensities_median_deviation)
  df_cv_after_processing = cbind(df_cv_after_processing,compute_cv(intensities))
}
```

```{r biological_error, results='asis'}

## Count extreme biological errors after pre-processing ##

# Initialization as an empty character string
df_cv_after_long$within_boundaries <- NA

# Looping through groups
for (group in group_ids){
  
  # Take a subset of the CV table containing only the current group
  sub = subset(df_cv_after_long,df_cv_after_long$Group==group)
  
  # Calculate the boxplot statistics
  whiskers = boxplot.stats(sub$value)$stats[c(1, 5)]
  max_whisker = whiskers[2]

  # Marking per their relation to the upper whisker (True = at or below, False = above, NA stays NA)
  df_cv_after_long$within_boundaries[df_cv_after_long$Group==group & df_cv_after_long$value <= max_whisker] <- TRUE
  df_cv_after_long$within_boundaries[df_cv_after_long$Group==group & df_cv_after_long$value > max_whisker] <- FALSE
  df_cv_after_long$within_boundaries[df_cv_after_long$Group==group & is.na(df_cv_after_long$value)] <- NA
}

# Keeping only values that were set to False (above the upper whisker)
df_cv_after_processing_outliers = subset(df_cv_after_long, df_cv_after_long$within_boundaries==F)

# Plotting a bar plot showing the extreme CV values/outliers detected within each group
bio_error_barplot <- ggplot(data = df_cv_after_processing_outliers) +
  geom_bar(aes(x=Group, fill=Group),alpha=0.8) +
  xlab("")+
  ggtitle("Extreme biological errors (boxplot outliers)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=22),
          axis.title=element_text(size=18),
          axis.text.y=element_text(size=18),
          axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90,size=18),
          legend.text=element_text(size=16),
          legend.title=element_text(size=18))

# Printing bio_error_barplot into output report (SVG or PNG)
if (format_svg) {
  htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(bio_error_barplot,"Extreme_biological_errors_(boxplot_outliers)", 10, 10))
} else {
  htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(bio_error_barplot,"Extreme_biological_errors_(boxplot_outliers)", 800, 800))
}
```

```{r pval_calculation_anova_kruskall, results='asis'}

## Pvalue calculation for Anova/Kruskall ##

# Clear pvalue_table
pvalue_table <- NULL

if(Test.type %in% c("anova","kruskall")){
  
  # If imputation is used, take logged or unlogged imputed values. Else, take unimputed logged or unlogged values
  if(imputation){
    if(Test.log==T){
      intensity_df = imputed_abundance_log
    }else{
      intensity_df = imputed_abundance
    }
  }else{
    if(Test.log==T){
      intensity_df = abundance_log
    }else{
      intensity_df = mean_abundance_repbio
    }
  }
  
  # Reshape intensity_df to anova test input (each row is one measurement and "variable" stores the group/sample ID)
  reshape_abundance = reshape2::melt(intensity_df,id="Id")
  for(cond in unique(expDesign$Condition)){
    reshape_abundance$variable = sub(paste0(".*", cond, "$"), cond , sub(paste0(pattern,".*"),"",reshape_abundance$variable))
  }
  
  # For each protein, subset the long-format abundance table and sun the global statistical test
  for(id in unique(reshape_abundance$Id)){
  
    # Keeping only abundance values for the current protein
    current_protein_intensities = subset(reshape_abundance,reshape_abundance$Id==id)
    
    # Anova Test
    if(Test.type=="anova"){
      
      # Run the anova test and get summary results
      anova = aov(current_protein_intensities$value~current_protein_intensities$variable)
      pval = summary(anova)[[1]][[1,"Pr(>F)"]]
      
      # Tukey post-hoc correction for pairwise comparison pvalues
      res <- t(TukeyHSD(x=anova, 'current_protein_intensities$variable', conf.level=1-Volcano.threshold.pvalue)[[1]])[4,]
      
    # Kruskal-Wallis Test
    }else if(Test.type=="kruskall"){
      
      # Kruskal test
      kruskal = kruskal.test(current_protein_intensities$value~as.factor(current_protein_intensities$variable))
      pval = kruskal$p.value
      
      # Wilcoxon pairwise test between groups
      res = pairwise.wilcox.test(current_protein_intensities$value,current_protein_intensities$variable,p.adjust.method="none")$p.value
    }
    
  # Checking if pvalue_table exists
  if(is.null(pvalue_table)){
      pvalue_table = data.frame(matrix(c(id,pval,res),nrow=1))
      colnames(pvalue_table) = c("Id","global_pval",names(res))
    }
    # Else, append this proteins p-value to the existing table
    else{ 
      add = data.frame(matrix(c(id,pval,res),nrow=1))
      colnames(add) = c("Id","global_pval",names(res))
      pvalue_table = rbind(pvalue_table,add)
    }
  
  }
  # Replacing "-" with "/" for column names
  colnames(pvalue_table) = sub("-", "/", colnames(pvalue_table))
}
```

```{r DA, results='asis'}

 #########################################################Pairwise statistics #########################################################

# Initializing the starting statistics table containing one protein per row
statDF = data.frame(filtered_data$Id,filtered_data$Accession,filtered_data$Label) #data
colnames(statDF) = c("Id","Accession","Label")

# Clean copy of identifier only DF
precv_statDF <- statDF

# Creating main output table, adding globally imputed abundance values by Id
output_t <- data[c("Id", "Accession", "Gene_name", "Label", "Specific_peptides")]
output_t <- dplyr::left_join(output_t, global_imputed_abundance, by = "Id")

# Statistic computing for each pairwise condition comparison
for (comparison in comparisons_to_display){
  
  # Splitting comparison string into 2 condition names
  couple = strsplit(comparison,"/")[[1]]
  A_name = couple[1]
  B_name = couple[2]
  
  # Starting a comparison-specific filtering table with identifier columns
  filtering_data <- data[c("Id", "Accession", "Gene_name", "Label", "Specific_peptides")]
  
  # Add abundance and identification columns for each of the comparison groups
  for(group in couple){
    
    # Subset for current group
    group_mean_cols <- grep(paste0("_", group, "_mean$"), colnames(global_mean_abundance_repbio), value = TRUE)
    
    if (length(group_mean_cols) == 0) {
      stop("No mean abundance columns found for group: ", group)
    }
    
    sel_global_mean_abundance_repbio <- global_mean_abundance_repbio %>% select(Id, all_of(group_mean_cols))
    
    # Adding the mean abundance column to the filtering table
    filtering_data <- filtering_data %>% left_join(sel_global_mean_abundance_repbio,by="Id")
    
    # For each raw file in this group, add raw intensity column and matching identification type column
    for(file in expDesign[expDesign$Condition == group,]$File){
      filtering_data <- cbind(filtering_data, data[grepl(paste0("^", file, "$"), colnames(data))])
      file <- sub("Intensity_", "", file)
      filtering_data <- cbind(filtering_data, data[grepl(paste0("^Identification_type_", file, "$"), colnames(data))])
    }
  }
  
  # Add all log-transformed abundance columns
  filtering_data <- cbind(filtering_data, data[grepl("_log$", colnames(data))])
  
  # Apply filtering to only the two conditions for comparison
  cond_fltr <- filter_dataset(filtering_data, c(A_name, B_name))

  # Extract filtered outputs
  filtered_data <- as.data.frame(cond_fltr[[1]])
  mean_abundance_repbio <- as.data.frame(cond_fltr[[2]])

  # Keep only imputed abundance rows that passed the comparison-specific filter
  imputed_abundance <- global_imputed_abundance[global_imputed_abundance$Id %in% filtered_data$Id, ]
  
  #################################### Biolding intensity tables for comparison groups #########################################################
  
  # Using imputed or non-imputed DFs depending on parameters
  if (imputation) {
    
    A_cols <- grep(A_name, colnames(imputed_abundance), value = TRUE)
    B_cols <- grep( B_name, colnames(imputed_abundance), value = TRUE)
    
    if (length(A_cols) == 0) {
      stop("No abundance columns found for group: ", A_name)
    }

    if (length(B_cols) == 0) {
      stop("No abundance columns found for group: ", B_name)
    }
    
    A <- data.frame(Accession = filtered_data$Accession, Label = filtered_data$Label, imputed_abundance[A_cols], check.names = FALSE)
    B <- data.frame(Accession = filtered_data$Accession, Label = filtered_data$Label, imputed_abundance[B_cols], check.names = FALSE)
    
  } else {
    
    A_cols <- grep(paste0("_", A_name, "_mean$"), colnames(mean_abundance_repbio), value = TRUE)
    B_cols <- grep(paste0("_", B_name, "_mean$"), colnames(mean_abundance_repbio), value = TRUE)
  
    if (length(A_cols) == 0) {
      stop("No abundance columns found for group: ", A_name)
    }

    if (length(B_cols) == 0) {
      stop("No abundance columns found for group: ", B_name)
    }
    
    A <- data.frame(Accession = filtered_data$Accession, Label = filtered_data$Label, mean_abundance_repbio[A_cols], check.names = FALSE)
    B <- data.frame(Accession = filtered_data$Accession, Label = filtered_data$Label, mean_abundance_repbio[B_cols], check.names = FALSE)
    
  }
  
  # Merging conditions A and B by protein identifiers
  totIntensities = merge.data.frame(A,B,by=c("Accession","Label"))
  
  # Calculate the average intensity across all intensity columns from both conditions
  totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_",comparison)] = apply(totIntensities[,3:ncol(totIntensities)],1,function(x) mean(x, na.rm=T))
  
  #################################### Computing Fold Change #########################################################
  
  # If using a paired test (fc calculated differently)
  if(Test.paired){
    
    # Calculate paired ratios for each paired replicate, converting them to log 2 space, averaging the log2 ratios and then converting them back to fold-change scale
    paired_ratios <- data.matrix(totIntensities[A_cols]) / data.matrix(totIntensities[B_cols])
    paired_ratios[paired_ratios <= 0] <- NA
    log_paired_ratios = log2(paired_ratios)
    totIntensities[paste0("fc_",comparison)] = 2^(rowMeans(log_paired_ratios))
    
  }else{
    
    # For unpaired comparisons, choose the DF based on the imputation parameters
    if (imputation && imputation_method == "MNAR") {
      totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_",A_name)] = rowMeans(data.matrix(totIntensities[grep(paste0("_", A_name, "_mean_imputed$"), names(totIntensities), value = TRUE)]),na.rm = TRUE)
      totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_",B_name)] = rowMeans(data.matrix(totIntensities[grep(paste0("_", B_name, "_mean_imputed$"), names(totIntensities), value = TRUE)]),na.rm = TRUE)
    } else if(imputation && imputation_method != "MNAR"){
      totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_",A_name)] = rowMeans(data.matrix(totIntensities[grep(paste0("_", A_name, "_mcar_imputed$"), names(totIntensities), value = TRUE)]),na.rm = TRUE)
      totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_",B_name)] = rowMeans(data.matrix(totIntensities[grep(paste0("_", B_name, "_mcar_imputed$"), names(totIntensities), value = TRUE)]),na.rm = TRUE)
    }else{
      totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_", A_name)] <- rowMeans(data.matrix(totIntensities[grep(paste0("_", A_name, "_mean$"), names(totIntensities), value = TRUE)]), na.rm = TRUE)
      totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_", B_name)] <- rowMeans(data.matrix(totIntensities[grep(paste0("_", B_name, "_mean$"), names(totIntensities), value = TRUE)]), na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Calculating fold change as A / B
    totIntensities[paste0("fc_",comparison)] = totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_",A_name)] / totIntensities[paste0("mean_intensity_",B_name)]
  }
  
  # Adding fc results to statDF
  statDF = merge.data.frame(precv_statDF,totIntensities[,c("Accession",paste0("mean_intensity_",comparison),paste0("fc_",comparison))],by="Accession")
  
  # If Fold.change is set to zscore, calculate a z-score of the log2 fold changes
  if(Fold.Change=="zscore"){
    statDF$zscore <- scale(log2(statDF[paste0("fc_",comparison)]),center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
  }
  
 ######################################################### Compute pvalues #########################################################
  
  # If pvalue_table exists and is not NULL, use the previously calculated Anova/Kruskal pvalues
  if(!is.null(pvalue_table)){
    
    # Merging the relevant pvalue columns for this comparison
    pval_cols <- c("Id", comparison)

    if (!all(pval_cols %in% colnames(pvalue_table))) {
      stop("Missing expected p-value columns: ", paste(setdiff(pval_cols, colnames(pvalue_table)), collapse = ", "))
    }
    
    statDF <- merge.data.frame(statDF, pvalue_table[pval_cols], by = "Id")
    colnames(statDF)[ncol(statDF)] <- paste0("pval_", comparison)
    
  # Else, do a T, Wilcoxon, or Limma test
  }else{
    
    # If the test should be performed on logged values, rebuild A and B accordingly
    if(Test.log==T){
      if(imputation){
        A_cols <- grep(paste0("_", A_name, ".*_imputed_log$"), colnames(filtered_data), value = TRUE)
        B_cols <- grep(paste0("_", B_name, ".*_imputed_log$"), colnames(filtered_data), value = TRUE)
      }else{
        A_cols <- grep(paste0("_", A_name, ".*_noimpute_log$"), colnames(filtered_data), value = TRUE)
        B_cols <- grep(paste0("_", B_name, ".*_noimpute_log$"), colnames(filtered_data), value = TRUE)
      }
      
      if (length(A_cols) == 0) {
        stop("No log abundance columns found for group: ", A_name)
      }
      
      if (length(B_cols) == 0) {
        stop("No log abundance columns found for group: ", B_name)
      }
      
      A <- data.frame(Accession = filtered_data$Accession, Label = filtered_data$Label, filtered_data[A_cols], check.names = FALSE)
      B <- data.frame(Accession = filtered_data$Accession, Label = filtered_data$Label, filtered_data[B_cols], check.names = FALSE)
      
      # Warning if using logged data for a Welch T Test
      if(Test.var.equal==F){
        cat(text_spec("\n"))
        cat(text_spec("Warning : intensities should not be transformed by log with a Welch test (variance not equal)",italic=T,font_size="12px"))
      }
    }
    
    # Do the statistical test
    if(Test.type=="limma"){
      
      # Performing Limma test
      if(Test.paired){
        
        # Creating paired design
        paired = c(seq(1,ncol(A)-2),seq(1,ncol(B)-2))
        design <- model.matrix(~factor(c(rep(1,length(A)-2), rep(2,length(B)-2))) + paired)
        colnames(design) <- c("Intercept","paired", "B-A")
      }else{
        
        # Unpaired design
        design <- model.matrix(~factor(c(rep(1,length(A)-2), rep(2,length(B)-2))))
        colnames(design) <- c("Intercept", "B-A")
      }
    
      # Building Limma input matrix from A and B columns
      data_limma<- cbind(A[,3:ncol(A)],B[,3:ncol(B)])
      
      # If accessions are unique, use directly as row names, Else append Id to duplicated accessions to make them unique
      if(sum(isUnique(filtered_data$Accession)) == length(filtered_data$Accession)){
        rownames(data_limma)=filtered_data$Accession
      }else{
        unique_rownames <- filtered_data %>%
          mutate(rowname = ifelse(duplicated(Accession) | duplicated(Accession, fromLast = TRUE),
                            paste(Accession, Id, sep = "_"),
                            Accession)) %>%
          remove_rownames() %>%
          column_to_rownames(var = "rowname")
        row.names(data_limma) <- row.names(unique_rownames)
        }
    
      # Fit Limma model and apply empirical Bayes moderation
      fit <- lmFit(data_limma, design)
      fit <- eBayes(fit)
  
      # Extract all Limma results
      alllimma<-topTable(fit, coef=2,adjust.method="BH",p.value=1,"P")
  
      # Extracting Limma pvalues and adding them to statDF
      alllimma$Accession = row.names(alllimma)
      statDF = merge.data.frame(statDF,alllimma[grep("Accession|P.Value",colnames(alllimma))],by="Accession")
      colnames(statDF)[ncol(statDF)] = paste0("pval_",comparison)
  
    # T.test / Wilcoxon test
    }else{
      
      # Initialize pvalue column for comparison
      statDF[paste0("pval_",comparison)] <- NA_real_
      
      # Loop over each protein and apply selected test
      for(prot in seq_len(nrow(A))){
        
        # T.Test
        if(Test.type=="t.test"){
          pval = t.test(as.numeric(A[prot,3:ncol(A)]),as.numeric(B[prot,3:ncol(B)]),
                      alternative,
                      paired=Test.paired,
                      var.equal=Test.var.equal)$p.value
          
        # Wilcoxon test
        }else if(Test.type=="wilcoxon"){
           pval = wilcox.test(as.numeric(A[prot,3:ncol(A)]),as.numeric(B[prot,3:ncol(B)]),
                      alternative,
                      paired=Test.paired)$p.value
        }
        # Add proteins pvalue to statDF
        statDF[paste0("pval_",comparison)][match(A[prot,1],statDF$Accession,nomatch =0),]<- pval
      }
      
    }
    
  }
  
 ######################################################### Multiple testing correction ######################################################### 
  
  # If an adjustment procedure was selected
  if(Test.adjust.procedure!="none"){
    
    # Significance evaluated using adjusted pvalues
    value="qval"
    procedure_results = mt.rawp2adjp(as.numeric(unlist(statDF[paste0("pval_",comparison)])), proc=Test.adjust.procedure, alpha=Test.adjust.FDR)
    qval = data.frame(procedure_results$adjp,procedure_results$index)[order(procedure_results$index),2]
  }else{
    
    # Significance will be evaluated based on raw pvalues
    value="pval"
    qval = rep(NA,nrow(statDF))
  }
  
  # Add adjusted pvalues to the statistics table
  statDF[paste0("qval_",comparison)] = qval
  
  ########################## Significant proteins ##########################
  
  # Ensure statistical result columns are numeric
  stat_cols <- grep("^(mean_intensity_|fc_|pval_|qval_)", colnames(statDF), value = TRUE)
  statDF[stat_cols] <- lapply(statDF[stat_cols], as.numeric)
  statDF[paste0("significant_",comparison)]<-rep(F, nrow(statDF))
  
  # Initially classify every protein as not significant
  statDF[paste0("significant_",comparison)][(statDF[paste0(value,"_",comparison)]<=Volcano.threshold.pvalue)
                                            & (abs(log2(statDF[paste0(Fold.Change,"_",comparison)]))>=Volcano.threshold.fc)] <- T
  
  ########################## Results displaying ##########################
  
  # Only results from comparisons specified by the user
  if(comparison%in%comparisons_to_display){
    
    # Extracting columns needed for comparison
    current_statDF <- statDF[c("Id","Accession","Label", paste0("mean_intensity_", comparison), paste0("fc_", comparison), paste0("pval_", comparison), paste0("qval_", comparison), paste0("significant_", comparison))]
    colnames(current_statDF) = c("Id","Accession","Label","mean_intensity","fc","pval","qval","significant")
    
    # Printing comparison name
    cat(text_spec(comparison, color="#3686D5", bold=T, font_size=18 ))
    
    # Printing filtering summary table for comparison
    cat(kable(cond_fltr[[4]], format="html", col.names = c("Filter", "Value", "Value_Percentage"), booktabs = T, caption = "Filtered Proteins") %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options="condensed",full_width = F,position = "center") %>%
            column_spec(1, bold = T))
    
    # Coloring of points (monochrome, by significance, or by intensity)
    if(Vol_colors == "significance"){
      col_sig <- TRUE
      monochrome <- FALSE
    }else if(Vol_colors == "intensity"){
      col_sig <- FALSE
      monochrome <- FALSE
    }else{
      col_sig <- FALSE
      monochrome <- TRUE
    }
      
    # Protein labeling in plot (none, specified list, automatic labeling)
    if(Vol_no_lab == T){
      prtn_lbl_lst <- ""
      lblng_mnl <- TRUE
    }else if(length(Vol_labels) > 0){
      prtn_lbl_lst <- Vol_labels
      lblng_mnl <- TRUE
    }else{
      lblng_mnl <- FALSE
    }
      
    # Setting colors and point sizes to be used
    sig_list <- c('black', 'red')
    col_list <- c('green4', 'yellow3', 'red3')
    pnt_sz <- 1.5
    
      
  ########################## Framing of MA plot using ggplot   ########################## 
    
    # Setting Current_statDF to only contain proteins with valid values
    current_statDF_MA <- current_statDF[!is.na(current_statDF$mean_intensity) &!is.na(current_statDF$fc) &is.finite(current_statDF$mean_intensity) &
      is.finite(current_statDF$fc) & current_statDF$mean_intensity > 0 & current_statDF$fc > 0,]
  
    #Selecting the top 50 most significant proteins with the smallest pvalues
    top_50_pval = current_statDF_MA %>% filter(significant==TRUE) %>% slice_min(pval, n = 50)
    
    # Creating MA plot with ggplot
    MA = ggplot(current_statDF_MA, aes(x=log10(mean_intensity), y=log2(fc))) +
      # Coloring by significance
      {if(col_sig) geom_point(aes(color=significant, alpha = current_statDF_MA$pval),size=ifelse(current_statDF_MA$significant, 2, 1.5))}+
      {if(!col_sig) geom_point(aes(color=-log10(pval), alpha = .7),size=pnt_sz)}+
      {if(col_sig) scale_color_manual(values = sig_list)}+
      # If monochrome coloring
      {if(monochrome && !col_sig) scale_color_gradient(low = 'lightblue', high = 'blue4')}+
      # If coloring by intensity
      {if(!monochrome && !col_sig) scale_color_gradientn(colors = col_list, values = c(0, .5, 1))}+
      # automatic labeling of top 50 proteins by significance (manual labeling is not enabled)
      {if(!lblng_mnl) ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = top_50_pval,aes(label=as.character(top_50_pval$Label)),
                                              hjust=1,vjust=-1, size=3, box.padding = .15,max.overlaps = 10)}+
      {if(!lblng_mnl) labs(subtitle = "Top 50 significant hits were labeled.")} +
      # Manually labeling by accession number
      {if(lblng_mnl) ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = ifelse(current_statDF_MA$Accession %in% prtn_lbl_lst, as.character(current_statDF_MA$Label),'')), 
                                              hjust=1,vjust=-1, size=3, box.padding = .15, max.overlaps = 10000)}+
      geom_hline(yintercept=log2(Volcano.threshold.fc),linetype="dashed") +
      geom_hline(yintercept=-log2(Volcano.threshold.fc),linetype="dashed") +
      ggtitle("MA plot")+
      xlab("log 10(Intensity)")+
      ylab(paste0('log2(',Fold.Change,')')) +
      theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(size=22),
        axis.title=element_text(size=24),
        axis.text=element_text(size=22),
        legend.text=element_text(size=16),
        plot.margin = unit(c(2,0,2,0), "cm"),
        legend.title=element_text(size=18)) +
      annotate("text", x = max(log10(current_statDF_MA$mean_intensity), na.rm = TRUE), y = min(log2(current_statDF_MA$fc), na.rm = TRUE),
             label = couple[2], hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6, font_face = "bold") +
      annotate("text", x = max(log10(current_statDF_MA$mean_intensity), na.rm = TRUE), y = max(log2(current_statDF_MA$fc), na.rm = TRUE),
             label = couple[1], hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6, font_face = "bold")
    
    # Adding a line break after the plot
    cat(text_spec("\n"))
    
  ########################## Graph Parameters   ########################## 
    
    # If multiple-testing correction procedure was used, adjust the colvano plot pvalue threshold
    if(Test.adjust.procedure!="none"){
      significant_df <- subset(current_statDF, qval < Volcano.threshold.pvalue)
      Volcano.threshold.pvalue <- max(significant_df$pval)
      
      if (nrow(significant_df) > 0) {
        Volcano.threshold.pvalue <- max(significant_df$pval, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    }
    
    # Remove rows where either fc or pval is NA
    cstat_noNA <- current_statDF[!is.na(current_statDF$fc) & !is.na(current_statDF$pval) & !is.na(current_statDF$mean_intensity) & is.finite(current_statDF$fc) &
      is.finite(current_statDF$pval) & is.finite(current_statDF$mean_intensity) & current_statDF$fc > 0 & current_statDF$pval > 0 & current_statDF$mean_intensity > 0,]
    
    # Setting coloring scheme (if colored by significance or intensity)
    if(col_sig){
      Significance <- cstat_noNA$significant
      Intensity <- log10(cstat_noNA$mean_intensity)
    }else{
      Intensity <- log10(cstat_noNA$mean_intensity)
    }
    
    # Creating a base volcano plot
    Volcano = ggplot(cstat_noNA, aes(x=log2(fc), y=-log10(as.numeric(cstat_noNA$pval))))
    
    # Modifying volcano plot
    Volcano = Volcano +
      # If coloring by significance
      {if(col_sig) geom_point(aes(color=cstat_noNA$significant, alpha = Intensity),size=ifelse(cstat_noNA$significant, 1.5, 1))}+
      # If not coloring by significance
      {if(!col_sig) geom_point(aes(color=Intensity, alpha = .7),size=pnt_sz)}+
      # Adding pvalue and fc threshold lines
      geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(Volcano.threshold.pvalue),linetype="dashed")+
      geom_vline(xintercept=log2(Volcano.threshold.fc),linetype="dashed")+
      geom_vline(xintercept=-log2(Volcano.threshold.fc),linetype="dashed")+
      # If monochrome mode selected
      {if(monochrome && !col_sig) scale_color_gradient(low = 'lightblue', high = 'blue4')}+
      # If no color scheme, color by intensity
      {if(!monochrome && !col_sig) scale_color_gradientn(colors = col_list, values = c(0, .5, 1))}+
      # If coloring by significance
      {if(col_sig) scale_color_manual(values = sig_list)}+
      # Automatically labeling significant proteins
      {if(!lblng_mnl) ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(cstat_noNA$significant==T,as.character(cstat_noNA$Label),'')),
                                              hjust=1,vjust=-1, size=3, box.padding = .15,max.overlaps = 15)}+
      # If manual labeling, label based on list of accession labels
      {if(lblng_mnl) ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = ifelse(cstat_noNA$Accession %in% prtn_lbl_lst, as.character(cstat_noNA$Label),'')), 
                                              hjust=1,vjust=-1, size=3, box.padding = .15, max.overlaps = 10000)}+
      ggtitle("")+
      xlab(paste0("log2(FC)"))+ 
      ylab(paste0('-log10(pval)'))+
      labs(color='log10(Intensity)') +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size=22),
            axis.title=element_text(size=18),
            axis.text=element_text(size=18),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            plot.margin = unit(c(2,0,2,0), "cm"),
            legend.title=element_text(size=18)) +
      # Adding group labels
      annotate("text", x = min(log2(cstat_noNA$fc), na.rm = TRUE), y = max(-log10(as.numeric(cstat_noNA$pval)), na.rm = TRUE),
             label = couple[2], hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 6, font_face = "bold") +
      annotate("text", x = max(log2(cstat_noNA$fc), na.rm = TRUE), y = max(-log10(as.numeric(cstat_noNA$pval)), na.rm = TRUE),
             label = couple[1], hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6, font_face = "bold")
    
    # Plotting and printing of Volcano plot into html (.svg or .png dependent on set parameters) with download link
    if (format_svg) {
      cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(Volcano,"Volcano", 12, 12)))
    } else {
      cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(Volcano,"Volcano", 1200, 1200)))
    }
    
    # Plotting and printing MA plot into html doc (.svg or .png dependent on set parameters) with download link
    if (format_svg) {
      cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(MA,"MA_plot", 12, 12)))
    } else {
      cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(MA,"MA_plot", 1200, 800)))
    }
    
  ########################## Volcano comparisons   ########################## 
    
    cat(text_spec("\n"))
  
  ########################## Creating data frame for heatmap  ########################## 
  
    # Only create the significant-protein heatmap if there is more than one significant protein
    if(length(current_statDF$significant[current_statDF$significant==T])>1){
      
        # Extract rows from current_statDF that were classified as significant
        significant_proteins <- subset(current_statDF, significant == TRUE)
        
        # Match significant proteins back to filtered_data by Id, preserving order
        matched_rows <- match(
          as.character(significant_proteins$Id),
          as.character(filtered_data$Id)
        )
        
        # Remove unmatched rows, if any
        matched_rows <- matched_rows[!is.na(matched_rows)]
        
        significant_proteins_data <- filtered_data[matched_rows, ]

        if (imputation) {
          intensity_cols <- grep(
            paste0("((", A_name, "|", B_name, ").*imputed_log$)"),
            names(significant_proteins_data),
            value = TRUE
          )
        } else {
          intensity_cols <- grep(
            paste0("((", A_name, "|", B_name, ").*_noimpute_log$)"),
            names(significant_proteins_data),
            value = TRUE
          )
        }
        
        significant_proteins_intensities <- significant_proteins_data[
          c("Accession", "Label", intensity_cols)
        ]
        
        # Renaming heatmap columns
        if (imputation) {
          colnames(significant_proteins_intensities) <- c(
            "Accession",
            "Label",
            sub(
              paste0(pattern, "_imputed.*"),
              "",
              colnames(significant_proteins_intensities)[3:ncol(significant_proteins_intensities)]
            )
          )
        } else {
          colnames(significant_proteins_intensities) <- c(
            "Accession",
            "Label",
            sub(
              paste0(pattern, "_noimpute_log.*"),
              "",
              colnames(significant_proteins_intensities)[3:ncol(significant_proteins_intensities)]
            )
          )
        }
        
        heatmap_values <- significant_proteins_intensities[, -c(1, 2)]

        heatmap_values <- data.frame(
          lapply(heatmap_values, as.numeric),
          check.names = FALSE
        )
        
        keep_rows <- complete.cases(heatmap_values) &
          apply(heatmap_values, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(as.numeric(x))))
        
        significant_proteins_intensities <- significant_proteins_intensities[keep_rows, ]
        significant_proteins_data <- significant_proteins_data[keep_rows, ]
        
        # Store the sample and group names used in the heatmap
        samples_names_comparison <- colnames(significant_proteins_intensities)[3:ncol(significant_proteins_intensities)]
        group_ids_comparison <- c(A_name, B_name)
        
        raw_mean_cols <- paste0(samples_names_comparison, "_mean")
        
        missing_raw_cols <- setdiff(raw_mean_cols, colnames(significant_proteins_data))
        
        if (length(missing_raw_cols) > 0) {
          stop(
            "Missing raw mean columns for imputed mask: ",
            paste(missing_raw_cols, collapse = ", ")
          )
        }
        
        raw_intensities_significant_proteins <- significant_proteins_data[
          c("Id", "Accession", "Label", raw_mean_cols)
        ]
        
        # Build imputed mask in the structure expected by create_heatmap()
        # Important: create_heatmap() looks for mask columns containing "mean"
        imputed <- data.frame(
          raw_intensities_significant_proteins[, c("Accession", "Label")],
          is.na(raw_intensities_significant_proteins[, raw_mean_cols, drop = FALSE]),
          check.names = FALSE
        )
        
        # create_heatmap() expects the first identifier column to be named "Id"
        # In this heatmap context, this "Id" is actually the row identifier used for plotting,
        # so we use Accession here to match significant_proteins_intensities.
        colnames(imputed)[1:2] <- c("Id", "Label")
        
        # Keep the original raw mean column names, because create_heatmap() uses contains("mean")
        colnames(imputed)[-(1:2)] <- raw_mean_cols
                
  ########################## Framing 'Heatmap' plot  ########################## 
        
        if (nrow(significant_proteins_intensities) >= 2) {
          
          heatmap_plot <- create_heatmap(
            significant_proteins_intensities,
            imputed,
            samples_names_comparison,
            group_ids_comparison,
            "Log Intensities Heatmap"
          )
  
          # Plotting and printing 'Heatmap' plot into html doc (.svg or .png dependent on set parameters) with download link
          if (format_svg) {
            cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(heatmap_plot,"Heatmap", 15, 15)))
          } else {
            cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(heatmap_plot,"Heatmap", 1200, 1000)))
          }
        }else{
          cat(text_spec(
            "Heatmap skipped: fewer than two proteins remained after filtering invalid heatmap values.",
            italic = TRUE,
            font_size = "12px"
          ))
        }
        
        # Convert heatmap intensity columns to numeric
        significant_proteins_intensities[, 3:ncol(significant_proteins_intensities)] <-
          lapply(significant_proteins_intensities[, 3:ncol(significant_proteins_intensities)], as.numeric)
        
        # Create z-scored heatmap matrix
        significant_proteins_intensities_z <- cbind(
          significant_proteins_intensities[, 1:2],
          t(as.data.frame(scale(t(significant_proteins_intensities[, 3:ncol(significant_proteins_intensities)]))))
        )
        
        # Extract z-scored values
        z_heatmap_values <- significant_proteins_intensities_z[, -c(1, 2)]
        
        z_heatmap_values <- data.frame(
          lapply(z_heatmap_values, as.numeric),
          check.names = FALSE
        )
        
        # Filter rows that became NA/NaN/Inf after z-scoring
        keep_rows_z <- complete.cases(z_heatmap_values) &
          apply(z_heatmap_values, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(as.numeric(x))))
        
        significant_proteins_intensities_z <- significant_proteins_intensities_z[keep_rows_z, ]
        
        # Create matching mask for z-scored heatmap
        imputed_z <- imputed[keep_rows_z, ]
        
        if (nrow(significant_proteins_intensities_z) >= 2) {
          
          heatmap_plot_scored <- create_heatmap(
            significant_proteins_intensities_z,
            imputed_z,
            samples_names_comparison,
            group_ids_comparison,
            "Log Intensities Heatmap (Z-scored)"
          )
          
          if (format_svg) {
            cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(heatmap_plot_scored, "Heatmap_scored", 15, 15)))
          } else {
            cat(htmltools::HTML(createPngOrSvg(heatmap_plot_scored, "Heatmap_scored", 1200, 1000)))
          }
          
        } else {
          cat(text_spec(
            "Z-scored heatmap skipped: fewer than two proteins remained after filtering invalid z-scored values.",
            italic = TRUE,
            font_size = "12px"
          ))
        }
        
      # Add spacing after the heatmap section in the HTML report
      cat(text_spec("\n"))
      
  ########################## Summary table   ########################## 
      
      # Merge the raw mean intensities for significant proteins with the statistical results for the current comparison
      map = merge.data.frame(raw_intensities_significant_proteins,current_statDF,by=c("Id"))
      map$Accession <- map$Accession.x
      map$Label <- map$Label.x
      map <- map[, !(names(map) %in% c("Accession.x", "Accession.y", "Label.x", "Label.y")), drop = FALSE]
      map <- map[, c("Id", "Accession", "Label", setdiff(names(map), c("Id", "Accession", "Label"))), drop = FALSE]
      
      # Removing columns that are not needed in the displayed significant-proteins table
      significant_proteins_table <- map[, !(names(map) %in% c("mean_intensity", "significant")), drop = FALSE]
      
      # All remaining columns are assumed to be numeric result/intensity columns.  If not NA, use protein row in table
      for (i in 4:ncol(significant_proteins_table)) {
        significant_proteins_table[[i]] <- ifelse(
          is.na(significant_proteins_table[[i]]),
          NA,
          formatC(as.numeric(significant_proteins_table[[i]]), format = "e", digits = 5)
        )
      }
      
      # Creating HTML datatable and apply styling
      sig_dt <- DT::datatable(significant_proteins_table,
        rownames = FALSE,
        extensions = 'Buttons',
        options = list(
          dom = 'Bfrtip',
          buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
          scrollX = TRUE
          )
        ) %>%
        DT::formatStyle(
          columns = colnames(significant_proteins_table),
          fontSize = '8pt',
          rowHeight = '30px'
        )
      
      print(htmltools::tagList(sig_dt))
      
    }
  }
  
  ########################## Add results to global table  ########################## 
  
  # Extracting the current comparison-specific statistical results from statDF
  current_statDF <- statDF[c("Id", "Accession", "Label", paste0("mean_intensity_", comparison), paste0("fc_", comparison), paste0("pval_", comparison), paste0("qval_", comparison), paste0("significant_", comparison))]
  
  # Creating and filling log10 pvalue column
  current_statDF[[paste0("log10_pval_", comparison)]] <- -log10(current_statDF[[paste0("pval_", comparison)]])
  
  # Creating and filling qvalue column
  current_statDF[[paste0("log10_qval_", comparison)]] <- -log10(current_statDF[[paste0("qval_", comparison)]])
  
  # Creating and filling log2 fc column
  current_statDF[[paste0("log2_fc_", comparison)]] <- log2(current_statDF[[paste0("fc_", comparison)]])
  
  # Removed quotation marks from column names
  # colnames(current_statDF) = c("Id", "Accession", "Label", "mean_intensity", "fc", "pval", "qval", "significant")
  
  ########################## output tables   ########################## 
  
  # Create a comparison-specific name for teh label column
  new_name <- paste0("Label (", comparison, ")")

  # Adding imputed or unimputed data
  if (imputation) {
    to_add <- filtered_data[
      grepl(paste0("((", A_name, "|", B_name, ").*_imputed_log$|Accession$|Label$)"), names(filtered_data))
    ][, -2]
  } else {
    to_add <- filtered_data[
      grepl(paste0("((", A_name, "|", B_name, ").*_noimpute_log$|Accession$|Label$)"), names(filtered_data))
    ][, -2]
  }
  
  
  # keep only columns not already in output_t, except Accession which is the key
  non_key_cols <- setdiff(names(to_add), "Accession")
  names(to_add)[names(to_add) %in% non_key_cols] <- paste0(non_key_cols, "_", comparison)
  to_add <- to_add[, c("Accession", setdiff(names(to_add), c("Accession", names(output_t)))), drop = FALSE]
  output_t <- merge(output_t, to_add, by = "Accession", all = TRUE)
  
  # Choose merge key
  if ("Id" %in% colnames(current_statDF) && "Id" %in% colnames(output_t)) {
    key_col <- "Id"
  } else if ("Accession" %in% colnames(current_statDF) && "Accession" %in% colnames(output_t)) {
    key_col <- "Accession"
  } else {
    stop("No common merge key found between current_statDF and output_t.")
  }
  
  # Select key plus columns not already in output_t
  stat_cols_to_add <- c(
    key_col,
    setdiff(names(current_statDF), c(key_col, names(output_t)))
  )
  
  # Keep only columns that really exist in current_statDF
  stat_cols_to_add <- intersect(stat_cols_to_add, names(current_statDF))
  
  stat_to_add <- current_statDF[, stat_cols_to_add, drop = FALSE]
  
  output_t <- merge(output_t, stat_to_add, by = key_col, all = TRUE)
  output_t$PresentInBoth <- !is.na(output_t$Label)
  

  # Get the column index of the column to be moved
  label_index <- which(colnames(output_t) == "Label")
  colnames(output_t)[label_index] <- new_name
  
  column_index <- which(colnames(output_t) == "PresentInBoth")
  colnames(output_t)[column_index] <- paste0("Kept for stat analysis (", comparison, ")")

  cdc <- grep(".*_log", colnames(output_t))
}

output_t <- rename(output_t, Accession_code = Accession)
output_t <- rename(output_t, GeneName = Gene_name)

indices <- match(og_Acc$Accession, output_t$Accession)
output_t <- output_t[indices, ]
```
